title: Original Python code samples (written for START)
author: START project (written for this project, 2026-11-05)
licence: Original to this project; not copied from any book
source: Written for START by a coordinator with three workers (compiler/interpreter, reverse engineering tool, custom transformers), assembled by the coordinator
method: Three components, each a set of self-contained stdlib-only Python programs: (1) a complete original language 'Minnow' — lexer, recursive-descent parser, bytecode compiler (31-opcode ISA), stack VM, plus a tree-walking interpreter on the same AST, REPL, 31 test programs run on both engines; (2) a reverse-engineering tool — .pyc reader/walker, disassembly reporter, control-flow analyser with call graph, static pattern scanner, pure-stdlib ELF parser, demonstrated on real repo files and real binaries; (3) AST transformers — constant folding, dead-code elimination, logging injection, loop optimisation, obfuscator/minifier, type-annotation adder, chained pipeline — each verified by behaviour preservation (transformed program produces identical observable output). All code original to this project; topics and standard techniques only, no book text or distinctive example copied. The compiler files duplicate the lexer/parser across files by design (self-containment), so unique code is less than the total.
verification: Coordinator re-ran all 18 programs with system python3 (3.12.3): every file exited 0. VM and tree-walk test suites 31/31 each with byte-identical agreement; REPL demo OK; reversing demos 251 checks passing (pyc/disasm/flow/scanner/elf, incl. real-file and real-binary inputs); transformer unit tests 96/96 passing with behaviour-preservation checks after every stage. Spot log review confirmed no hidden failures (the words 'error'/'fail' in logs are the passing error-program tests and demo code snippets, not failures).
notes: The compiler component (312,298 chars) overshot its 150k-250k target because of the instructed self-containment duplication; unique code is ~110k chars. Left out deliberately: no for loops / dicts / string interpolation / file I/O in Minnow; no exception-path logging; no loop unrolling; obfuscator keyword-arg rewriting only for direct bare-name calls to local functions/classes. The mini-VM limitation from the Rust batch does not apply here.
